profile.headline: Cyber Security and IT Operations Specialist
profile.summary: IT and cybersecurity-focused professional with experience designing and supporting enterprise system environments, specializing in solution architecture, system integration, and secure infrastructure design. Skilled in cloud technologies (AWS, Azure), data architecture, and designing scalable systems that align with business and operational goals. Experienced in translating requirements into technical architectures, designing and supporting enterprise system environments, and implementing security best practices aligned with NIST RMF and compliance frameworks. Proven ability to collaborate across teams to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable IT solutions.

positions.title: Real Estate Agent at TruLine Real Estate
positions.description:
Accountable for running and operating a self-owned real estate business with the goal of providing real estate services across California. Must allocate funds and procure sales, while establishing a relational network amongst other industry professionals. 
Leverages network of industry professionals and community connections to increase visibility and reach potential clients.
Adopts a client-centric approach, understanding unique needs and goals and regularly communicating with clients throughout the buying or selling process.
Provides exceptional customer service to facilitate concerns and ensure a positive experience.
Utilizes digital marketing tools such as professional websites and social media presence to increase online engagement and reach.
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Python (Programming Language) · HTML · Management · Microsoft Excel · Cross-functional Team Leadership · MySQL · Pycharm · Sales · Real Estate · Microsoft Visual Studio Code · Visual Studio

positions.title: Command and Data Handling Mentor
positions.description:
Responsible for providing Command and Data Handling (CDH) mentoring for 400+ science/engineering students from multiple institutions to achieve their Mission Concept Academy team design to a Preliminary Design Review level. 
Conceptualized telecommunication methods utilizing research on antenna arrays, radio frequency bands, bit rate data, laser communication relays, inverse square law, and more.
Mapped logic flow and sub-system interconnectivity through the use of a software architecture flowchart supported by an N^2 diagram.
Validated CDH systems through requirement tables exploring ideas of telemetry in space, on Mars, the Lunar surface, and the orbit of Enceladus.
Held weekly CDH meetings delving into the use of hardware components such as radiation hardened onboard computers, transponders, data buses, solid state drives, and so forth. 
Provided constructive feedback on deliverables following technical writing protocols while looking for requested information in sections of the documents. Provided Requests for actions if needed.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Management · Microsoft Excel · Cross-functional Team Leadership · Pycharm · JavaScript · C++ · Printed Circuit Board (PCB) · Siemens NX · Microsoft Visual Studio Code · Arduino IDE · Gantt Project · GitHub · Visual Studio

positions.title: Team Design Mentor
positions.description:
Responsible for guiding 200+ industry professionals from Australia and New Zealand to completion of deliverable submissions. 
Established a team dynamic by assisting with team role delegation to garner the team’s interest in a field of discipline within the academy for multiple teams.
Conducted weekly team meetings to observe teamwork and development of mission design for deliverables while dealing with conflict management for the teams. 
Documented technical conversations and questions to maintain ITAR compliance.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Management · Microsoft Excel · Cross-functional Team Leadership · Pycharm · JavaScript · C++ · Printed Circuit Board (PCB) · Microsoft Visual Studio Code · Arduino IDE · Gantt Project · GitHub · Visual Studio

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Drafted pseudo-code that followed a step-by-step process of checking if a camera system’s shutter was closed with the use of a photoresistor, and then using a motor to open and close the shutter while taking and storing 15 pictures in an interval of 3 loops.
Programmed an Arduino Itsy-Bitsy M4 to record 15 data sets using multiple functions that were capable of plotting pixel locations that varied in color in order to output those number sets as an image.
Conducted data analysis on a CPU via Python commands on Visual Studio Code and the Arduino integrated data environment to get back thermal target temperature readings, system temperature readings, shutter positioning, stored pictures, and executed commands.
Wired PCBs’ with various components, using a soldering iron to bond wires avoiding cold soldering joints. 
Integrated multiple pieces of computer hardware such as an Arduino Itsy-Bitsy M4, and Adafruit Perma-Promo Quarter-sized Breadboard PCB that used formulated algorithms to make the system function properly and receive data. 
Successfully engineered a thermal camera system capable of operating in a vacuum of 5 torr that collected instrument data whilst following ESP protocol.
